profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer | Technical Lead
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience across verticals (education, retail, insurance, government, healthcare), with a proven track record of developing and delivering robust solutions to complex business and technical challenges, enabling integration, process improvement and stability, increasing stakeholder confidence. 

Capable of managing and prioritizing multiple streams of work to meet critical business needs. A problem solver and motivator with leadership potential, bringing a spirit of service and commitment to any potential employer. 

Cross-functional team player with a customer service background, possessing strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish lasting relationships, business or personal, with excellent oral and written communication skills.

positions.title: Service Engineer | Technical Lead
positions.description: Integral part of an Agile team, and resident integration SME, providing expertise in all phases of the SDLC from RFP to deployment, delivering the next generation Tier 1 System-of-Record using cutting-edge technologies in the Cloud and On-prem, garnering a “Standing Ovation” employee recognition from Senior Management. Respected by peers and leadership, ensuring requirements, designs, processes, and standards were either established or adhered to, delivering maintained levels of system quality and stability for all users, especially clients. A consistent frontliner, collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders in a cross-functional manner, with a track record of providing exceptional levels of support.

positions.title: Service Engineer | Technical Lead
positions.description: Led and mentored a team of Junior TIBCO BusinessWorks developers (5 – 8) throughout all phases of the SDLC, delivering new functionality and enhancements to real-time and batch services, maintaining overall system stability of at least 98% for several hundred deployed instances across data centers, for a critical Tier 1 enterprise application. Experienced in cross-functional collaboration, supporting business and technology stakeholders, garnering a “Standing Ovation” from a client for exceptional support, for building an ad hoc process to remediate a backlog of data, due to a week-long service shutdown resulting from an enterprise-wide disaster recovery exercise. The “Standing Ovation” led to winning the 2017 “Reach for the Stars” award – the highest level of employee achievement.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Provided best-in-class consulting services throughout all phases of the SDLC, focusing on the successful delivery of quality solutions using TIBCO technologies in the areas of EAI and CEP, in support of key business initiatives across verticals (education, retail, insurance, government), for a respected, top-ranking software company.
